package demo;
public class Weak extends BWebServlet {
  public void doPost(WebOp op) {
    if (!perms.has(BPermissions.operatorRead)) return;
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void doPut(WebOp op) {
    user.check(this, BPermissions.adminRead);
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void doGet(WebOp op) {
    check(x);
    has(x);
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void doDelete(WebOp op) {
    if (!perms.has(OPERATOR_READ | ADMIN_READ)) return;
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
}
